name: vscode-sashiko
description: Run Sashiko Linux kernel patch reviews using the language model already configured in VS Code — no LLM_API_KEY required.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Review the attached or open .patch/.mbox files

commands.name: changes
commands.description: Review the uncommitted changes in the working tree

commands.name: commits
commands.description: Review a git revision or range, for example HEAD~3..HEAD

commands.title: Sashiko: Review Patch File in Active Editor
Sashiko: Write Settings.toml for Current Session

sashiko.executable.markdownDescription: Sashiko executable used to run reviews. Use `sashiko` for `sashiko review`, or `sashiko-cli` together with `#sashiko.reviewArgs#` set to the `local --force-local` form.

sashiko.reviewArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the Sashiko executable. Supports the `${range}`, `${settings}` and `${repository}` placeholders.

sashiko.repositoryPath.description: Path to the Linux kernel git repository under review. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

sashiko.model.description: Pins reviews to one VS Code chat model. Leave empty to follow the model selected in the chat view. Change it with the 'Sashiko: Select Language Model' command.

sashiko.provider.description: Provider name written to Settings.toml. Older Sashiko releases spell it 'openai-compat'.

sashiko.worktreeDir.description: Directory Sashiko uses for review worktrees, relative to the repository.

sashiko.concurrency.description: Number of concurrent reviews. Keep this low: every request consumes your VS Code chat model quota.

sashiko.maxInputTokens.description: Maximum input tokens per request. Capped to the selected model's limit when that is smaller, and Sashiko warns about models that cannot hold this much context.

sashiko.bridgePath.description: Path to the sashiko-vscode-bridge binary. Empty uses the binary shipped with the extension.

sashiko.publishDiagnostics.description: Publish review findings as diagnostics in the Problems panel.

scripts.package: npm run build:rust && npm run compile -- --production && vsce package
